description: This Java source file defines the class `InvoiceSystemAdapter`, which implements the `InvoiceSystemPort` interface. It provides a method to send client information to an invoice system using JMS messaging. The class is annotated as a Spring component and uses dependency injection for JMS template. It also uses logging to trace message sending.

classes.name: InvoiceSystemAdapter
classes.description: Spring component implementing `InvoiceSystemPort` to send client info via JMS.

methods.name: sendProjectInfo
methods.description: Sends client project info to the invoice system via JMS message, setting correlation ID for tracking.
